title: Max Points on a Line
goal: Solve Max Points on a Line: For each anchor point, hash the reduced slope to every other point and find the largest bucket.
strategy: For each anchor point, hash the reduced slope to every other point and find the largest bucket.
edgeCases: Vertical lines need a separate slope representation, and repeated coordinates must count without dividing by zero.
inputRules: Each point must contain two safe integers: [x, y].
Points must be distinct, as required by this problem.
